pages.9712: Shipping Policy SkyyRose LLC · skyyrose.co Last updated: June 5, 2026 This Shipping Policy explains how SkyyRose LLC (“SkyyRose,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) processes, ships, and delivers orders placed on skyyrose.co. By placing an order you agree to the terms described below. For questions not answered here, contact us at info@shopskyyrose.com. Contents Order Processing Times Domestic Shipping (US) International Shipping Customs, Duties & Import Taxes Order Tracking Pre-Order Shipping Lost, Stolen, or Delayed Packages Incorrect Address & Undeliverable Packages Contact 1. Order Processing Times All orders are processed within 1–3 business days (Monday through Friday, excluding US federal holidays) from the date payment is confirmed. During new collection drops or major holiday periods (e.g., Black Friday/Cyber Monday, Christmas), processing may extend to up to 5 business days due to elevated order volume. Orders are not shipped or delivered on weekends or US federal holidays. Once your order has been dispatched you will receive a shipping confirmation email containing your tracking number and a link to track your shipment in real time. Note: Processing time is separate from and in addition to the carrier transit times listed in the sections below. 2. Domestic Shipping (US) We offer the following shipping options for orders delivered within the contiguous United States, Alaska, and Hawaii: Method Estimated Delivery Time Cost Standard Shipping 5–7 business days $17 Express Shipping 2–3 business days $22 Free Standard Shipping 5–7 business days Free on orders $200.00 or more (before taxes) Delivery time estimates begin on the day of shipment (after processing) and are provided by the carrier. SkyyRose does not guarantee delivery dates and is not responsible for carrier delays outside our control. The free standard shipping threshold is calculated on the pre-tax merchandise subtotal. Shipping charges, taxes, and fees do not count toward the threshold. The discount is applied automatically at checkout when the threshold is met. 3. International Shipping SkyyRose ships to 40+ countries worldwide. Shipping rates for international orders are calculated dynamically at checkout based on the destination country and the total weight and dimensions of your order. You will see the exact shipping cost before completing your purchase. Estimated international delivery time is approximately 10–14 business days from the date of shipment, depending on the destination country, customs processing times, and carrier routing. Some destinations may experience longer transit times due to local postal infrastructure or regulatory requirements. International shipping availability and rates are subject to change. SkyyRose reserves the right to restrict shipping to certain countries or regions at any time. 4. Customs, Duties & Import Taxes When an order is shipped to a destination outside the United States, it may be subject to import duties, customs fees, value-added tax (VAT), goods and services tax (GST), or other charges levied by the destination country. These charges are the sole responsibility of the recipient. SkyyRose does not collect, pre-pay, or reimburse import duties, customs fees, or taxes of any kind. These amounts are not included in the shipping cost displayed at checkout or charged at the time of purchase. Customs and regulatory processing by destination-country authorities may cause additional delays beyond the estimated transit times stated above. SkyyRose has no control over customs clearance timelines and cannot be held responsible for delays resulting from customs inspection or regulatory review. If a package is refused or returned due to non-payment of import duties or failure to clear customs, the customer is responsible for any resulting return shipping fees, and the original shipping cost will not be refunded. 5. Order Tracking Once your order has been shipped, you will receive a shipping confirmation email containing your tracking number and a direct link to the carrier’s tracking portal. Tracking information may take up to 24 hours to appear in the carrier’s system after the confirmation email is sent. To track your order: Open your shipping confirmation email and click the tracking link, or Visit the carrier’s website and enter your tracking number manually, or Log in to your account on skyyrose.co and view the order status under My Orders. If you did not receive a shipping confirmation email within 5 business days of placing your order, please check your spam or junk folder before contacting us at info@shopskyyrose.com. 6. Pre-Order Shipping Certain SkyyRose products are available for pre-order in advance of their production or release date. The following terms apply to all pre-order purchases: Payment: Your card is charged in full at the time of pre-order, not at the time of shipment. Estimated ship date: The estimated ship date for each pre-order item is displayed on the product page at the time of purchase. These dates are estimates and may be subject to change due to production, supply chain, or logistics factors. Separate shipment: Pre-order items ship separately from any in-stock items included in the same order. You may receive multiple shipments and tracking numbers for a single order containing both in-stock and pre-order items. Cancellations: Pre-orders may be cancelled for a full refund up to 48 hours before the estimated ship date. After that threshold, the standard Refund & Return Policy applies once the item has been delivered. Notifications: You will receive an email notification when your pre-order item has been dispatched, including a tracking number. For full pre-order terms, including cancellation rights and payment conditions, please review our Terms of Service. 7. Lost, Stolen, or Delayed Packages SkyyRose is not responsible for packages that are lost, stolen, or delayed after the carrier has accepted and scanned the shipment. However, we will do our best to assist you in resolving delivery issues. If your package appears lost or significantly delayed: Verify the shipping address on your order confirmation matches your intended delivery address. Check with neighbors, building management, or any safe-drop location specified at checkout. Allow up to 3 additional business days beyond the estimated delivery date before reporting a loss, as carrier delays can cause temporary tracking gaps. Contact us at info@shopskyyrose.com with your order number and tracking number. We will open an investigation with the carrier on your behalf. If your package is marked “Delivered” but you have not received it: Check all possible delivery locations (mailbox, front door, parcel locker, reception desk). If the package cannot be located, contact us at info@shopskyyrose.com within 7 days of the marked delivery date so we can initiate a carrier claim. Carrier delay disclaimer: Delivery time estimates are provided by the carrier and are not guaranteed. SkyyRose is not liable for delays caused by carrier operations, weather events, natural disasters, strikes, acts of government, or any other circumstances beyond our reasonable control. 8. Incorrect Address & Undeliverable Packages The customer is solely responsible for providing an accurate and complete shipping address at the time of checkout. SkyyRose is not responsible for orders shipped to an incorrect or incomplete address provided by the customer. If you realize you entered an incorrect address, contact us immediately at info@shopskyyrose.com. Address corrections can only be made before the order enters the fulfillment queue. Once the package has been dispatched, we cannot guarantee that an address change is possible. If a package is returned to us by the carrier as undeliverable due to an incorrect address, a failed delivery attempt, refusal of delivery, or an unclaimed parcel, the following applies: We will contact you using the email address on file to arrange reshipment. Reshipment to the corrected or original address will be charged at the applicable shipping rate. If you do not respond within 30 days of our notification, the order may be subject to restocking and the merchandise refunded minus the original shipping cost and any applicable restocking fee. Original shipping costs are non-refundable for packages returned due to an incorrect address or failed delivery resulting from customer error. 9. Contact For shipping inquiries, order status questions, or to report a delivery issue, please reach out to our customer support team: Email: info@shopskyyrose.com Mailing address: SkyyRose LLC, 3400 Cottage Way, Suite G2, Sacramento, CA 95825 We aim to respond to all inquiries within 1–2 business days. Response times may be longer during high-volume periods such as new collection launches and major holiday seasons. For returns or exchange inquiries, please see our Refund & Return Policy. For general legal or terms inquiries, contact legal@skyyrose.co. pages.10146: Refund & Return Policy SkyyRose LLC · skyyrose.co Last updated: June 5, 2026 We want you to love every SkyyRose piece. If something is not right, we make it straightforward to return or exchange — because the relationship matters more than the transaction. Contents Overview / Our Promise Return Window & Eligibility How to Start a Return Refunds Exchanges Non-Returnable Items Damaged, Defective, or Incorrect Items Pre-Order Cancellations & Refunds International Returns Late or Missing Refunds Contact 1. Overview / Our Promise SkyyRose LLC (“SkyyRose,” “we,” “us,” or “our”) stands behind everything we put our name on. If a piece does not work for you — wrong size, not what you expected, or arrived with a defect — we will make it right. This policy applies to all purchases made on skyyrose.co. Please read this policy carefully before initiating a return. By completing a purchase on our site, you agree to the terms set out below. This policy is incorporated into and should be read alongside our Terms of Service and Shipping Policy. 2. Return Window & Eligibility We accept returns on eligible items within 30 days of the confirmed delivery date shown in your shipping confirmation. Eligibility requirements To be accepted for return, items must be: Unworn and unwashed — never put on beyond a brief size check, and free of deodorant, fragrance, or any staining. In original condition — no stretching, pilling, or alteration of any kind. Tags attached — all original hang tags and care labels must be in place exactly as shipped. In original packaging — returned in the original polybag, box, or mailer as received, along with any inserts or tissue included at time of shipment. Items that do not meet every one of these conditions will be returned to sender at the customer’s expense and will not be eligible for a refund or exchange. 3. How to Start a Return Email us at info@shopskyyrose.com with your order number and a brief reason for the return (e.g., “wrong size,” “item not as described”). Please include your name and the email address used at checkout. Receive your prepaid label — for US orders, we will reply within 24 hours (business days) with a prepaid USPS return shipping label attached. Keep a copy of the label for your records. Pack your item — place the item in its original packaging, ensure tags are still attached, and seal the package securely. Drop it off — take the sealed package to any USPS location or hand it to your mail carrier. We recommend requesting a drop-off receipt for your records. Track your return — the label we provide includes tracking. You can monitor delivery status using the tracking number on your label. Once we receive and inspect the returned item, we will process your refund or exchange as described in the sections below. We will send a confirmation email when the return is received and again when the refund or exchange is processed. 4. Refunds Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method used at checkout within 5–7 business days of our receipt and inspection of the returned item. Your financial institution may take additional time to post the credit to your account; please allow up to 10 business days total before contacting us. What is refunded The full purchase price of the returned item(s). Any applicable taxes collected on the returned item(s). What is not refunded Original outbound shipping costs are non-refundable, except in cases where the item arrived damaged, defective, or materially different from what was ordered (see Section 7). Gift wrapping or other add-on service fees, if applicable. If your return is rejected because the item does not meet eligibility conditions, we will notify you by email. The item will be returned to you at your expense; we will provide a payment link before reshipping. 5. Exchanges US customers Exchanges for a different size or color of the same style are free for US orders. Here is how it works: Email info@shopskyyrose.com with your order number and the size or variant you need. We will send a prepaid USPS return label and confirm the replacement item is in stock. Ship your original item back within 14 days of receiving the prepaid label. Once we receive and inspect the original, we will ship your replacement at no additional charge. If the requested replacement item is out of stock, we will offer you a refund or the option to be notified when it becomes available. International customers International customers are responsible for the cost of return shipping to our US facility. Once we receive and inspect the original item, we will reship the replacement at no additional charge. Original return shipping costs paid by international customers are non-refundable. 6. Non-Returnable Items The following items are not eligible for return or exchange under any circumstances, unless they arrive damaged, defective, or incorrect (see Section 7): Final Sale items — any item marked “Final Sale” at the time of purchase. This designation is shown clearly on the product page and at checkout. Worn, washed, or altered items — items that have been worn, laundered, dry-cleaned, or altered in any way. Items without original tags — hang tags or care labels that have been removed or detached. Gift cards — digital and physical gift cards are non-refundable and cannot be exchanged for cash. Customized or personalized pieces — items made to order, monogrammed, or otherwise personalized at the customer’s request. We reserve the right to decline returns that do not meet the eligibility criteria described in Section 2 or that fall within the non-returnable categories above. 7. Damaged, Defective, or Incorrect Items We inspect every order before it ships, but if your item arrives damaged, has a manufacturing defect, or is materially different from what you ordered, we will make it right at no cost to you. What to do Contact us at info@shopskyyrose.com within 7 days of the confirmed delivery date. Include your order number and clear photographs showing the damage, defect, or incorrect item — full-item shots plus close-ups of the specific issue. We will review your submission and respond within 2 business days with resolution options. Resolution options Replacement — we ship the correct or defect-free item at no charge, along with a prepaid return label for the original. Full refund — including original outbound shipping costs — issued to your original payment method within 5–7 business days of our receiving the returned item. Claims submitted more than 7 days after the confirmed delivery date may not be eligible for a damage or defect resolution. Please inspect your order promptly upon receipt. 8. Pre-Order Cancellations & Refunds When you place a pre-order on skyyrose.co, your payment card is charged at the time of the pre-order. The estimated ship date is displayed on the product page and in your order confirmation email. Cancellation window You may cancel a pre-order for a full refund up to 48 hours before the estimated ship date shown in your order confirmation. To cancel, email info@shopskyyrose.com with your order number and “Pre-Order Cancellation” in the subject line. Refunds for approved cancellations are processed to your original payment method within 5–7 business days. After the cancellation window closes Once the 48-hour pre-cancellation window has passed, your order enters production or fulfillment and can no longer be cancelled before shipment. After your pre-order is delivered, the standard return policy set out in this document applies in full. Additional terms governing pre-orders — including estimated lead times, order splits, and force-majeure delays — are set out in our Terms of Service. 9. International Returns We ship to 40+ countries. International customers who wish to return an item must follow the same eligibility and process requirements described in Sections 2 and 3, with the following additional notes. Return shipping International customers are responsible for arranging and paying for return shipping to our US facility. We recommend using a tracked, insured service. SkyyRose is not responsible for packages lost or damaged in transit back to us. Duties, taxes, and customs fees Original outbound duties, import taxes, and customs fees paid at time of delivery are generally not refundable by SkyyRose. You may be able to reclaim these charges directly through your country’s customs authority — procedures vary by jurisdiction. We recommend contacting your local customs office for guidance. Refund processing Once we receive and inspect a valid international return, we will issue a refund to the original payment method (excluding original shipping costs and any duties or taxes collected at destination) within 5–7 business days. 10. Late or Missing Refunds If you have not received your refund after the timeframe stated in this policy, please take the following steps before contacting us: Check your bank or payment account — log in and search for a pending credit from SkyyRose or our payment processor (Stripe or PayPal). Processing can take 3–5 additional business days beyond our issuance date. Contact your card issuer or bank — some institutions hold credits before posting. Your bank’s customer service team can confirm whether a credit is pending. Check your PayPal balance — if you paid via PayPal, the refund may appear as a pending balance in your PayPal account. Contact us — if you have completed the steps above and still have not received your refund, email info@shopskyyrose.com with your order number and the date of our refund confirmation email. We will investigate and follow up within 2 business days. 11. Contact For all return, exchange, and refund inquiries, please contact us through any of the channels below. Include your order number in all correspondence to help us assist you quickly. Purpose Contact Returns, exchanges, refunds, shipping, general support info@shopskyyrose.com Legal notices legal@skyyrose.co Registered mailing address SkyyRose LLC 3400 Cottage Way, Suite G2, Sacramento, CA 95825 Our support team operates Monday through Friday. We aim to respond to all inquiries within 1 business day and within 24 hours for return label requests. This policy is governed by the laws of the State of California, United States, without regard to conflict-of-law principles. See our Terms of Service for the full dispute-resolution and governing-law clause.
